t: This is 66 Old Church Street in Chelsea, also known as Levy House. It's a modernist house, designed between 1935 and 1936 for the politician and playwright Benn Levy. The architects were Walter Gropius and Maxwell Fry. Gropius founded the Bauhaus and is widely regarded as a pioneering master of modernist architecture. He emigrated from Germany to England in 1934, then on to the United States in 1937, so this house comes from his short time in Britain. Fry was an English modernist architect, writer and painter, who worked with him here.
